    • importPetriNet

      com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.workflow.domain.eventoutcomes.petrinetoutcomes.ImportPetriNetEventOutcome importPetriNet(ImportPetriNetParams importPetriNetParams) throws IOException, com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.petrinet.domain.throwable.MissingPetriNetMetaDataException, com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.petrinet.domain.throwable.MissingIconKeyException
